say:16:1610612010:0.source_cn: 各位莱希拉姆的同学，请不必惊慌。我是耀光帝国特使<st...

say:18:1610612012:0.source_cn: 更何况，这次遇害的事一位在魔法界举足轻重的人物。王室非...

say:21:1610612014:0.source_cn: 那个……你真的没有把我们当成杀人凶手吗？

say:22:1610612015:0.text: I have only just begun the investigation. This is a standard procedure.
say:22:1610612015:0.source_cn: 我才刚刚开始调查，这只是所有调查都会有的正常流程而已。

say:23:1610612016:0.text: Hearing what you just said actually makes me feel a little better... Madam Durella never said anything that reassuring.
say:23:1610612016:0.source_cn: 听你这么说，我好像没有那么害怕了……杜瑞拉女士刚才都没...

say:26:1610612017:2.text: As students of the Serene Lyceum, you represent this school's image. You should have stronger composure than ordinary people. Pippa, you need to work on that.
say:26:1610612017:2.source_cn: 作为能够代表莱希拉姆形象的优秀学生，你们应该有比普通人...

say:27:1610612018:0.text: With respect, Headmistress Durella, comments like that only make her more nervous.
say:27:1610612018:0.source_cn: 恕我直言，杜瑞拉女士，你这样会加剧他们的紧张感。

say:28:1610612019:1.text: That wasn't my intent. I only wish for them to perform their best.
say:28:1610612019:1.source_cn: 我没有这样的意思，我只是站在代理校长的角度上，希望他们...

say:29:1610612020:0.text: If there are no further questions, let us begin.
say:29:1610612020:0.source_cn: 如果没有别的问题，我们就开始吧。

say:30:1610612021:0.text: Headmistress Durella, as the Lyceum's representative, you will remain present to ensure I employ no improper methods.
say:30:1610612021:0.source_cn: 作为校方代表和监督人，杜瑞拉女士，你需要全程在场，证明...

say:31:1610612022:1.text: Of course. That is my duty as acting headmistress.
say:31:1610612022:1.source_cn: 当然，这是我身为代理校长的职责。

say:33:1610612023:1.text: When your name is called, follow me inside. The rest of you, wait here quietly and do not leave.
say:33:1610612023:1.source_cn: 请叫到名字的人随我进来，其余人在此安静等候，不要离开。
